g.text: EL1 read-modify-write chains are slow because PSTATE.SSBS = 0 at EL1; setting SSBS = 1 matches EL0

text.style: fill: #52514e; font: 9px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: A bare ldr;str chain costs 1.5 ns with SSBS = 0 (EL1 default, or EL0 with SSBS cleared) and 0.33 ns with SSBS = 1; empty loops and PAN pairs are unaffected.

text.style: fill: #8a8984; font: 7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Data: docs/data/2026-10-10/0941-ssbs-rmw-chain.json (table exp_ops: median ps per op of 7 repeats; one dot per boot, 2 boots per condition; s0 / s1 = the loop wrapped in msr ssbs,#0 / #1).

g.text: Journal: 2026-10-10 09:41 (The EL1 RMW chain = PSTATE.SSBS; branch not merged). SSBS = 1 inside fragments weakens kernel-mode Spectre-v4 posture (not analysed in the entry). Platform: M1/HVF
